profile.lead_asset: KER-065 (activin ligand trap); elritercept (KER-050) partnered/licensed to Takeda
profile.indication: Duchenne muscular dystrophy (KER-065); anemia/cytopenias in myelodysplastic syndrome and myelofibrosis (elritercept)
profile.modality: Engineered TGF-beta superfamily ligand-trap fusion proteins (modified activin receptor)
profile.flag: Lead program churn: cibotercept discontinued after TROPOS PAH failure + corporate restructuring/leadership changes

profile.summary: Crinetics develops oral, nonpeptide small-molecule agonists and antagonists of endocrine GPCRs, displacing injectable peptide analogs; its lead PALSONIFY (paltusotine) is the first FDA/EMA-approved once-daily oral SST2 agonist for acromegaly, backed by atumelnant, an oral ACTH-receptor (MC2R) antagonist for CAH and Cushing's.
profile.lead_asset: Paltusotine (PALSONIFY) — oral SST2 agonist; atumelnant — oral ACTH/MC2R antagonist
profile.indication: Acromegaly (approved) and carcinoid syndrome; congenital adrenal hyperplasia and ACTH-dependent Cushing's syndrome (atumelnant)
profile.modality: Oral nonpeptide small-molecule GPCR agonists/antagonists (plus CRN09682 nonpeptide drug conjugate for SST2+ NETs)
profile.flag: Pending acquisition by Vertex Pharmaceuticals (announced 2026)

profile.summary: Theravance is effectively a single-product COPD company built around YUPELRI (revefenacin), the first once-daily nebulized long-acting muscarinic antagonist, and is winding down R&D after its pipeline hope ampreloxetine (a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor for symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension) missed the Phase 3 CYPRESS endpoint.
profile.lead_asset: YUPELRI (revefenacin) — marketed; ampreloxetine terminated after Phase 3 CYPRESS miss
profile.indication: Maintenance treatment of COPD (YUPELRI); symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (ampreloxetine, discontinued)
profile.modality: Small-molecule inhaled/nebulized LAMA bronchodilator (revefenacin); oral NET inhibitor (ampreloxetine)
profile.flag: Pending acquisition by Zymeworks at $17/share cash + CVR; ampreloxetine program ended, ~60% opex cut

profile.summary: LianBio was a China-focused biopharma that in-licensed Western assets (e.g., mavacamten, infigratinib, NBTXR3) for the Greater China and Asian markets rather than discovering its own drugs; in 2024 it rejected Concentra's buyout offer, wound down operations, sold remaining assets, and returned ~$528M to shareholders via a special dividend before delisting from Nasdaq.
profile.lead_asset: In-licensed regional rights portfolio (e.g., mavacamten, infigratinib, NBTXR3) — divested during wind-down
profile.indication: Cardiovascular, oncology and other conditions (regional China/Asia commercialization licensee)
profile.modality: In-licensing / regional development-and-commercialization licensee (no proprietary discovery platform)
profile.flag: DELISTED — wound down operations in 2024, returned cash to shareholders via special dividend; trades only OTC as LIANY shell
